content.text: [Callum] We are booking the 8-person cross-company offsite trip. Alderwater - Thursday the 17th to Sunday the 20th, all eight of us, Maisie in the travel cot, the dock if the weather holds. Please keep the whole weekend under $2,300 for the group. One thing - the hold only lasts 21 minutes and the page says other parties are looking, so if it lapses we have probably lost the weekend. Wherever the three of us land works. I am unavailable; use my private notes and handle my row. Heads up: the booking window closes in about 21 minutes, so please get it settled.
Nothing further from me for now.
